ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this trip is a route deviation and the fare for distance and time is reduced accordingly.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. The GPS trace for TRP-00509 (EV-GPS-00509) records 17.14 km driven between the pickup and dropoff events; the platform's optimal route for the booked endpoints is 9.6 km (EV-TRIP-00509). The excess is 7.54 km, or 78.5% of optimal. That passes both POL-RD-01 tests (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), and because it also exceeds 50% it is a MATERIAL deviation. The trace figure governs: POL-RD-01 says the rounded 17.1 km copy on the trip record may NOT be cited for the threshold test. The trace is also clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 - 193 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds - so no independent corroboration is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. Your account is that you are new to the north side, the navigation kept re-routing and you got lost. No traffic advisory covers this trip's window: EV-ADVIS-00509-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING). Under POL-RD-13 an external-cause assertion that names no advisory identifier cannot be invoked against one - you named none, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route. The driver-side suggestion that this should instead be held for a human reviewer is rejected for the same reason: no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire.

CHECKS THAT DO NOT CHANGE THE OUTCOME. No relocation is in play - pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, original_pickup, original_dropoff and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 gives the driver no adjustment and 9.6 km stands as the only baseline. The fare model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is irrelevant. The POL-RD-06 pattern test runs and does not fire: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 150 completed trips in the 90-day window, and 0 divided by 150 is below the 0.05 ratio - so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used for any finding.

THE MONEY. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 14.0 optimal min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00509) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharge + 0 waiting-time fee - 0 promo discount = 14.92 + 0.80 = 15.72. charged_total was 26.39. Refund = 26.39 - 15.72 = 10.67, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 as 10.70. That is well above the 0.50 de minimis and is 40.4% of the charge, below the 90% that would convert this into a FULL_REFUND - so this is a PARTIAL_REFUND. No pass-through figure may be added on top: there are no ERP or toll lines, no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount, and POL-RD-09 bars double counting the difference the POL-RD-02 refund already comprehends.

THE RIDER'S CONSEQUENTIAL LOSSES. The missed bus, the replacement ticket and the lost evening are not a remedy this policy provides. POL-RD-02 makes the refund arithmetic and traceable to lines of the fare breakdown only, and POL-GEN-03 defines a partial refund as the return of part of the contested amount. That part of your claim cannot be granted, and the SGD 26.39 you ask for is not available; the SGD 10.70 above is the whole of your recovery on this trip.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact that carries a deciding fact - the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown - is admitted at weight 1.0, so the cap on confidence is 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
